skill_interface: project summary and axis evidence in; E/S/G responsibility map out
source_policy: Use admitted KOFPI procedure context and the sealed Stage-derived axis contract.
tool_policy: No institutional inference, registration, certification, transaction, or external action.
guardrail: Never declare ESG completeness from absorption evidence alone.
validation_rule: Every E/S/G axis exists and gaps remain explicit.
trace_policy: Record claims, evidence collections, gaps, and applied status rule.
approval_policy: Human review is required before publishing an ESG completeness claim.
invocation_contract: One immutable project evidence snapshot per run.
release_policy: Axis or actor-role changes require new fingerprint and fixtures.
